summaries.Good news: Science is delivering real breakthroughs that improve lives—from a drug that may actually cure hormone-related high blood pressure to innovative methods capturing whale genomes without harm. Human kindness is thriving too, with a pub owner creating a stunning holiday display to lift spirits in his struggling town.
summaries.Ideas: AI is fundamentally reshaping how we work and design, from the emergence of 'design slop' requiring new defensive strategies to prototypes becoming the most effective specification tool, while also raising serious concerns about autonomous weapons and corporate accountability.
summaries.Technology: Electric vehicles are getting smarter and more capable—from solar-integrated charging solutions to powerful plug-in hybrids—while smart home and gaming devices continue evolving, though cybersecurity threats to critical infrastructure remain a persistent challenge.
summaries.Design: Design thinking is celebrating its evolution at major institutions while exploring provocative ideas through installation art, with furniture and product designers deeply engaging with lived experience—from NYC urban living to Japanese culinary traditions—and pushing boundaries on what objects can communicate.
